name: SPT-CL J0512-3848 (Hubble)
blurb: SPT-CL J0512-3848, a massive galaxy cluster, seen by Hubble.
label: sptclj05123848-hubble
story: This massive galaxy cluster showed signs of strong gravitational lensing, so Hubble studied it as a candidate natural telescope for magnifying far more distant galaxies.

claims.text: SPT-CL J0512-3848 is a cluster of galaxies and gravitational lens targeted by Hubble
The program observed new massive clusters with strong lensing evidence to calibrate them as cosmic telescopes for JWST
